title: Special Topics in Latin Literature; Latin Readings: Lucretius.
description: In this course we will read all of Lucretius epic poem, De rerum natura , written in six books. To hone our skills in reading and comprehending Latin poetry, we will read selections of the poem in the original Latin,using the edition of B. Catto. The rest of the poem will be read in E nglish. Throughout the course we will explore Lucretius poetry and sty le, his arguments about the nature of the universe, and the principles of Epicureanism; more generally we will consider the culturaland political context of the poem and ancient thinking about science, philosophy, and religion.
